component.name: Observer Core
component.summary: Local-first micro-agents that sense your screen, camera and audio

description.p: Observer Core lets you define small agents that continuously look at your screen, your camera or your audio, ask a local language model to interpret what they see, and act when a condition is met: a desktop notification, a message, a memory, or a short clip.
Everything runs on your machine by default. There is no Observer Core server. Cloud models and messaging channels are optional and clearly labelled.
Concept after Observer AI by Roy3838 (https://github.com/Roy3838/Observer), AGPL-3.0.
